title: Fusion Workflow Verification Report
description: Schema for script-based (API-only) verification results after testing Falcon Fusion workflow YAML files

workflows.description: Verification results for each workflow tested

workflow_name.description: Name of the Fusion workflow verified (from the YAML 'name:' field or filename)

run.description: Run number (1-based) when verifying multiple workflows

validate.description: Whether validate.py preflight + structural validation passed

deploy.description: Whether import_workflows.py deployed the workflow successfully

execute.description: Whether trigger_workflow.py executed the workflow to a terminal state

results.description: Whether get_execution_results.py reported a successful execution status

cleanup.description: Whether the deployed test workflow was deleted during cleanup

notes.description: Any issues, warnings, timings, or observations during verification
